planets.name: HD 106315 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 106315 with a 9.58-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: HD 106315 b was found in 2017 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around HD 106315. Its orbit and size follow Barros et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
